about: Vectors for the x402/exact/hedera/transfer-executor pairing, from x402's own example at 8228bd6d. idDigest is the payer's, printf '%s' '0.0.5001' | sha256sum; openssl dgst -sha256 and Python hashlib printed the same. A row settles where the payer is the one account the record debits and the record credits the payee; the asset and amount are recorded and judged by nothing. The staking-reward rows add a reward of 12345 tinybars to x402's example as HIP-406 records one: the rewarded account's credit in transfers includes the reward, 0.0.800 pays it, and staking_reward_transfers lists it. Each parent entry with transfers carries charged_tx_fee, the fee the Mirror Node's Transaction records as charged to the fee payer; here it is the fee payer's 5000000-tinybar debit, credited to 0.0.3 and 0.0.98; x402's example states no fee. A row's reference fields override the status reference. The status rows give executorStatus's answer under the profile read-status at the one mark, consensus, asked about the act payment unless a row's query says otherwise. The named transaction id is single-use (x402-exact-hedera.md, rule 15): a failed result under it answers failed, transaction-failed; a success that is not the payer's payment to the payee, one crediting another account or debiting another account than the payer among them, failed, instrument-consumed; and with no entry under it that decides, pending, instrument-live, until its valid start plus 180 seconds is strictly before the mirror's latest consensus timestamp, and failed, instrument-unused, after it, the mirror holding records back to that valid start.

pairingOf.source: a quote that omits executors cannot be paid

notOption.case: the payment whose accepted is the file's option O, given to reference beside another option the seller offers (O with payTo 0.0.4002, and O with amount 200000000): it answers another option, x402/accepted-not-option, the two compared by their RFC 8785 forms

rows.case: the named transaction debits the payer and credits the payee: settled
only the fee moved: the record debits no account, its fee payer is no payer, and it names no account: instrument-consumed
the named transaction's failed result consumed its id: transaction-failed
no entry under the named id (the mirror's 404), its valid start plus 180 seconds not yet passed: instrument-live

no entry under a named id whose nanoseconds are written in one digit, 0.0.9000-1755499920-5: its valid start is 1755499920.000000005, the nanoseconds an integer as the id's spelling writes them, so its valid start plus 180 seconds, 1755500100.000000005, is before the mirror's latest consensus timestamp: instrument-unused
the child credits 0.0.4002 instead of 0.0.4001: it names another account than the payee's, instrument-consumed

status.about: executorStatus reads the transaction the facilitator names as the act at coverage none: its merged record's one debited account is the payer where its digest is the one reference recorded, it pays where it credits the payee, what moved is recorded and judged by nothing, and its transaction id is single-use. Each row's entries are what GET /api/v1/transactions/{id} answers (null for its 404); mirror gives the reader's latest consensus timestamp and the start of its oldest block, a row's own mirror members replacing them. The expected answers were written by hand. Each transfer of what moved is named by the transaction id and its place, the asset and the credited account, `<asset>/<account>` (x402-exact-hedera.md, rule 14).

plant.case: a debit from an account other than the payer settles nothing: instrument-consumed

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.

rows.name: B6
rows.note: presented is this file's bound payment, as the file holds it; no signature was made for this row.

boundAccepted.case: The file's payment presented under options this pairing's read does not offer, each the payment's own option changed as the row's case names, or another pairing's option: bound holds the presented accepted to the option filter read applies and refuses each with the row's code, the code advertise gives that option (x402/option-not-this-pairing for an option that is not this pairing's). payment is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into this file.
